sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 09.10.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 CrlM.C.No. 8135 of 2024  :2: 2024:KER:75223  ORDER Dated this the 9th day of October, 2024.

This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, to quash all further proceedings in Crime No.2091/2023 of Aluva Police Station, Ernakulam, where the offences alleged are punishable under Sections 376(2)
Sojin vs State Of Kerala on 9 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56473171/
1 (n) and 313 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The petitioner herein is the accused in the above case.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner argued at length to convince this Court that none of the offences made out, prima facie, from the prosecution records.

Since he failed in this endeavour and when this Court is about to dismiss this petition, holding that there are sufficient materials to proceed with the investigation, the learned counsel for the petitioner sought permission to withdraw this petition.
Accordingly, this petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
Registry is directed to forward a copy of this order to the trial court and the victim, within three days, for information.
